format: local OmniDR research and delivery review

S1.scope: Full 986.069 s local audio transcription read; sampled visual reading; claim-critical frames inspected.
S1.limits: A live unboxing, not an instrumented handset laboratory test.

S2.scope: Full release body read; device launch, display circuitry and front-camera paragraphs verified.
S2.limits: Manufacturer claims; no independent quantitative verification of advertised improvements.

S3.scope: Specification text read and eight original product panels opened; used independent-drive and wiring panels viewed and cropped.
S3.limits: Same producer as S2. Marketing graphics are explanatory illustrations, not measured micrographs.

S6.scope: Display, camera, facial-recognition sections and published selfie photograph read and inspected, including author and publication date.
S6.limits: Different unit and setting from source video; web-resized sample, not a matched full-resolution test.

S8.scope: Abstract and all 10 PDF pages read; primary reading notes saved; Fig. 3 inspected.
S8.independence_group: Feng et al. CVPR2021 research team
S8.limits: Axon 20 experimental setup; neither measured PSF nor network metrics transferred to Axon 40 Ultra.

S11.independence_group: Song et al. ICCV2023 research team
S11.limits: Only abstract-level scattering model statements used; no full-paper or deployment claims.

S12.independence_group: Yang et al. ICCV2023 research team
S12.limits: The throughput improvement belongs to an optical simulation design, not this handset.

primary_reader_notes: See source_readings and _work/S8/reading.json; author abstracts alone used for S11/S12.

claim_reviews.claim: 2022 Axon 40 Ultra; 1600万屏下前摄与6400万后摄分开评价。
claim_reviews.review: Supported; product and year independently confirmed by primary specifications.

claim_reviews.claim: 整屏外观与近距离局部融合良好。
claim_reviews.review: Supported within shown viewing conditions; not a display uniformity instrument measurement.

claim_reviews.claim: 可见圆环受到原厂膜开孔影响。
claim_reviews.review: Supported by actual removal and post-removal view; angles/settings not fixed; no film-based selfie improvement inferred.

claim_reviews.claim: 一驱一、透明走线、MRC属于显示链。
claim_reviews.review: Supported by exact official definition and visible UI; no claim of individual sensor-photosite display control.

claim_reviews.claim: 400 PPI和蓝钻排列不要求两区发光单元形状完全相同。
claim_reviews.review: Supported and explained dimensionally. No aperture ratio, transmission or PPI measurement derived from video micrograph.

claim_reviews.claim: UDC通过衰减、衍射及散射损伤成像；亮点和饱和尤其重要。
claim_reviews.review: Mechanistic inference, not a handset measurement. SNR scaling explicitly assumes fixed exposure and photon-noise-dominated conditions.

claim_reviews.claim: 源片确实展示自拍，并保留一定毛发轮廓。
claim_reviews.review: Supported. Distinguishes phone-screen enlargement from directly inserted portrait/hair crop. Does not omit the video’s positive evidence.

claim_reviews.claim: 独立同款自拍柔化、人脸识别体验不稳定。
claim_reviews.review: Supported as a different unit’s reported experience. No paired comparison, statistical failure rate or security conclusion.

claim_reviews.claim: 2.24 μm描述融合效果，灵透3.0名称不足以保证输出画质。
claim_reviews.review: Supported with exact manufacturer wording; native sensor pitch is not asserted.

claim_reviews.claim: 后续相位掩模方案体现光路协同设计方向。
claim_reviews.review: Limited to abstract’s optical simulation. No claim the commissioned handset adopted it or doubled throughput.

claim_reviews.claim: 本机透过率、PSF/MTF、原始自拍、同场景对照及重复解锁结果仍缺失。
claim_reviews.review: Evidence gap disclosed. Follow-up test plan is explicitly a recommendation, not performed experimentation.
